Best restaurant in Vietnam
Aug 2024 • Friends
Honestly this is the best restaurant I ve tried in Vietnam by far. Traditional Vietnamese cuisine and the food is just amazing. Perfect environment, you can chill and relax inside a very comfortable space. Food and ingredients are fresh and so tasty! You have to try the spring rolls, crab soup and most of all the simmed pork ribs in fish sauce! The best I ve ever tried. The staff is so good and I met the owner. He cares a lot about ingredients and some of them comes from his farm! Highly recommended.
